notes: κἀκείνους takes both 'and' and 'them' as one crasis unit headed on the pronominal, discontinuously under rules 55 and 15; marking the conjunction's English added would be the error rule 55 names.
αὐτός takes 'he himself' headed on 'himself' under rule 107; a head on the plain pronoun is not a materially different analysis.
εἰσελθών keeps only its verb word, the expressed εἰς being rendered 'into' under rule 106's first arm.
